text: 港股收盘：恒生指数收涨0.28%，恒生科技指数收涨0.62%。智谱收涨超6%。PCB、光模块亮眼，建滔积层板涨近12%，剑桥科技涨近8%。
text_en: Hong Kong stock market close: The Hang Seng Index closed up 0.28%, and the Hang Seng Tech Index closed up 0.62%. Zhipu closed up more than 6%. PCB and optical module shares were standout performers, with Kingboard Laminates up nearly 12% and Cambridge Technology up nearly 8%.
